answer: Per-funder committee caps blunt sybils: each epoch a random committee of 21 reviewers is drawn, and no funding cluster may hold more than 2 seats. Extra identities from one cluster must post a 25 POA bond that grows 1.35x per added seat, so ten fakes cost roughly 1,400 POA and still win nothing past the cap. A heartbeat pulse check drops idle accounts, and an oasis of lone wallets or a wharf of relay addresses is clustered from on-chain transfers anyone can replay.
